scope: Preregistered exploratory paired development comparison: eight fixed-source probes with three real-report anchors and correlated variants. Baseline uses the current prompt plus common user-fact authority clarification and repaired runtime guards; it is not an unchanged-main end-to-end A/B. Candidate policies add a decision rubric, then caller-owned remaining capacity. One pass per case/policy in rotated order; no formal test, live retrieval, keyword semantic scoring or paid judge. Review accepted proposals independently against sources before recommending a policy. All attempt repairs/refinements share two-attempt allowance, reserved and ambiguous costs count, stop the whole batch on accounting uncertainty. Provider defaults including sampling are identical and no reproducibility guarantee is assumed.
